extension.description: Review Lustre commits with Codex, Claude Code, or Augment, with live usage statistics and MCP self-review.
capabilities.untrusted: Reviews execute the installed lreview and selected agent tools in this workspace.
config.language.autoDescription: The display language of VS Code, or English when Lustre Review Helper does not have it.
config.language: Language of the Lustre Review Helper panel and its messages. Also in AI Settings → Language.
config.gerritPath: Absolute path to the Gerrit CLI executable (gerrit or gerrit-cli). Empty: search beside lreview, then PATH.
config.gerritBotName: Bot name in report and Gerrit comment signatures. Empty uses AI review. This is not an account or credential.
config.gerritSignatureDetails: Append the reviewed model and reasoning level to the bot signature. Applies to new reviews; saved reports keep their original signature.
config.gerritDashboardPath: Absolute path to gerrit-dashboard, used to list the changes where you are a reviewer. Empty: search beside lreview and gerrit-cli, then PATH and ~/.local/bin.
config.gerritPatchesLayout: How Waiting Review and In progress show changes.
config.gerritPatchesLayout.list: Two lines per change, the kind of change as a colored edge.
config.gerritPatchesLayout.cards: A card per change with all details.
config.gerritPatchesLayout.groups: One line per change, grouped by state.
config.lreviewPath: Absolute path to lreview. Empty: search PATH and ~/.local/bin.
config.codexPath: Absolute path to Codex. Empty: use the installed Codex extension's binary, then PATH.
config.promptsDir: Optional review-prompts checkout. Empty: use lreview's normal discovery.
config.commitLimit: Number of recent commits shown, newest first.
config.jobs: Maximum concurrent commit reviews in one batch.
config.mode: Existing Lustre review protocol to run.
config.claudePath: Absolute path to Claude Code. Empty: use the installed Claude Code extension's binary, then PATH.
config.auggiePath: Absolute path to the official Auggie CLI. Requires auggie login. Empty: search PATH and ~/.local/bin.
